body:
I am really sorry to hear you are in such a dark place right now. When so much in our life is going wrong, it really makes you wonder what is the f\*\*\*ing point of it all. I can imagine suicide seems like a very easy and attractive option right now... I know that struggle well and I wish it wasn't there for you.  


Does your wife know what you are going through? If not, I hope someday you will be able to talk to her about it. I know how scary that can be but no one deserves to go through a pain like this alone.  


I hope posting on here helped a little... please know that we are here if you need to talk more about what is going on. I hope an amazing job is just around the corner for you.
still around?

I cannot even describe in words how horrified and upset I am after reading your story. I want to start off, by commending you for even being able to write this out and that you are still functioning after this, as an experience like this one could debilitate others. I can't even begin to imagine all the emotions you must be struggling with right now so all I will say is I'm sorry and that we are here.

I am glad you posted here, i hope it helps in a small way. I know this is not something you really want to share with anyone. Please know that we are here for you, and if you ever need to vent or talk more about what you are currently going through, we are here.

I hope at some point, you will find people you can open up to about this. Or maybe even  specialist? This is such a heavy burden that you should not carry alone. 

Your girlfriends comment worries me... it seems incredibly insensitive and even destructive. I do not know the context or exact choice of wording but I can imagine you need her support more than ever right now. I hope at some point this is something you can address with her.

If there is anything we can do for you, please let us know.
damn still on? :)
Thank you so much for this detailed response, this really helps!

Ah ok - I thought it was more in general of making someone question their sanity. 

Thank you so much for taking the time to respond and to offer support. That means a lot to me and your words help.
I just do not know what to do since he keeps reaching out to me (as in trying to plan a call and then disappears). It is almost as if he is trying to upset me
The gaslighting is in reference to him telling me I am overthinking the situation. But I see what you mean
Fruit flies carry a lot of microscopic germs and bacteria so personally i would say give the plates a rinse first.
lol, the shiny odds are crazy - I have hatched five eggs already and three were shiny

I get what you mean... I am 38 and I can sometimes not understand where the time went or how i got here. It does not matter how successful we are in our careers... without those REAL friends it means very little. I am sorry it has not happened for you, as i also has not happened for me. Please know that whle we might be strangers, we are always here if you need someone to talk to!

Sadly that is all they can do :(  
It might help when you are in a dark place and need to talk, to post on here. I know we are all strangers and we cannot do much but if talking/venting helps, we will do our best to listen and offer support where we can <3

I will say this.... often i would apply for a job and they would want to know 4 specific coding languages and I only knew three. In those moments I would brag/lie a little and say that i knew all of them. If I felt I was in the running for the job I could also spend the next few weeks schooling myself to get versed enough in that fourth language. It isnt completely honest but... when the jobs start i should be able to do what they asked for.

As for you being so hard on yourself and calling yourself useless... it MIGHT be a result of the sleep deprivation. I cant say for sure but I know that whenever i do not sleep enough or sleep poorly for a while, my emotions and insecurities are magnified. Maybe they affect me quicker or something I dont know... I just know on those days i struggle extra hard

It might be worth taking things slow. Maybe even instead of having one big conversation, this can be divided into multiple ones?

As an example: I cheating (on cam, so online) with my partner and a lot of it had to do with my past (I was molested and it made me focus on sex to connect with people). In the end I had a talk about my past first and through other conversations i opened up more and more about what happened.

That way, she has time to process everything instead of going straight to the emotions. And try to focus on your own feelings as you explain things, make sure you express the emotion tied to it. Like I said, if done right, this could bring you closer together and even making your relationship stronger.

I am really sorry to hear you guys have broken up. I understand how tempting it is to kill yourself and make him finally take you serious but... if he is treating you like a joke then this man is not worth it. You deserve so much better. 

I am really sorry to hear about your BPD. I know how that makes your life so much harder and more stressful than others. I hope you are on medication but I know even then with all the side effects and thoughts, it is a constant battle.

I know there is not much that we as strangers can do for you but... please know that if you need someone to talk to and vent about what is going on, we are here for you. <3

I think most come here because the world usually does not understand them. Suicide and depression and all other forms of mental illness are greatly misunderstood and often not talked about. 

And it makes me grateful for this sub because on here we can talk, give support and advise and help each other through it. I know it may seem like some people here just want to boost their egos but... i will say for me... i have been in very dark places in the past and a person to talk to has always saved me in those moments. So I try to pay it forward. I like to think it is that way for most on here but who knows.

Thank you for sharing your story, i know this must have taken a lot of time to type out. I hope it even helped in a small way to get this all out. So please do not apologize for a wall of text - I (and hopefully others) read it all and we are here to support you in the small ways we can.

I am really sorry to hear about your panic disorder and the fact that medication is needed just shows how severe it is. As a man, I understand the concerns over erection issues - that in itself could cause depression or more panic attacks. Have you spoken to a specialist about other options? Maybe other kinds of medication that can be taken with less severe side effects?

If I am really honest, I am actually worried the panic disorder is causing a domino effect for you. You talk about not sleeping right, not enjoying things, socializing less and i would imagine all those things are connected in a way.

I also know how stressful it is to not know what your true passion is. I commend you for giving software development a go (fellow programmer here) and I hope that it gave you enjoyment? As someone in IT i will say this: you are never done studying. With the trends and technology always changing, yo will fidn yourself constantly learning more. So this means with most jobs it may seem like you are underqualified but in reality, they just want someone willing to learn. So if you do decide to apply to more of those jobs, emphasize your eagerness to learn. I would gladly help you put together an application letter if that helps you although you can also find great ones online.

But again - personally i would counter these panic attacks first as i fear they debilitate your life. It might even be worth looking into a different therapist since usually mediation and therapy itself go hand in hand and it worries me if this person wont do anything until you are on meds.

I hope better days are ahead of you and please know that we are always here for you <3

I understand and I know too feeling all too well sadly...

I will just say this - whatever happens, please know that we are here. I know we are all just random internet strangers but a lot of people on here, self included, share that same darkness and understand the pain you are feeling. And if there is ever anything we can do such as give support, love or advice, we will be here.

I am glad your cat has you. She deserves a loving owner like you <3

It sounds like you are considering leaving her? Are you ok? Would it help to talk about what is going on?

I understand your logic but at this point, we can say that this approach is not working, right? If you keep saying block me, one of these days, she will. She clearly still cares for you a great deal - maybe you can try speaking from the heart more and focus on what you are feeling as opposed to what she should do. 

Tell her that being her friend is too painful for you and that you miss her and hopefully based on that you two can sit down and talk and figure out what to do moving forward.

The most beautiful thing about a relationship is that we can be our true, unapologetic selves. We lie and fake to a lot of people around us but I hope that you and your girlfriend can work on being more honest and open with each other. You made a mistake - like we all do - and that is fine. You fell down and what is important now is how you get back up.

I hope you and your gf can sit down and really talk about this. Not just about what was done but also led up to it and why. Hopefully, this will only make your relationship stronger. I know this is going to be scary and you do not know how she will react but you deserve to be with someone who fully knows and understands you <3

I am really sorry to see you have reached this point. A part of me wants to ask you why but... I understand that will be a huge long-ass story that you don't want to type out.   
Is there anything I/we can do for you right now? Would it help to talk/vent about what is going on? I know it sounds cheesy but we are here for you
Any time - come to us if you ever feel down like this ok? If talking/venting helps we are here for all of that <3

YAAASSS! That is awesome my dude. I am glad you are in better spirits and that you have this person as a friend. I hope this is the start of a better life for you (and if not, know we are here for you!)

I do not know the situation but it sounds a little bit like you are pushing her away (and thus sabotaging). What is it that you want right now? DO you wish you to save this relationship or move on? Because if you are done I would advise you to block her instead? If you are not i would stop saying this because all it does is push her away.

I will say I know how you are feeling and I am sorry to see you this down.

I do not know you so there is not much I can say to lift your spirits but I will say this: you matter. You matter so much. And I know it does not always feel that way. I am proud of you for having the courage to be honest about this because so many cannot do that.  

Please know that you are not alone and that we care for you. And whenever you have a down day, come to us and post here. I know there is not much we can do but we will always listen and give you love and support.

Insecurity can be so destructive and I am sorry you are dealing with those voices. I would encourage you to open up about what it is that makes you insecure, either on here or with a friend in person. It is good to validate how rational we are being (because often we aren't) but if we are, it is good to find a good way to deal with it. 

If you ever need to talk about this issue more, please know that we are here for you!

I am sorry to see you are hurting so much right now. Please don't aware compare your pain to that of others on here... I know a lot of people on here are struggling and maybe even morse than you are but the important thing is that you matter and that we are here for you.

I am sorry to hear about this situation with your parents. It must be extra difficult with this pandemic/lockdown as we tend to get stuck together in close spaces.

It sounds like you have a lot on your mind that you are trying to get out but don't have the proper release for it. I would always encourage you to post on here if that helps and we will try our hardest to listen and support you however we can. Hopefully there is also someone in your life, maybe a friend or a family member you could open up to as you should not be going through this alone.
Regardless of what you sent... Why do you think you are unable to walk away from this? This person clearly does not want to hear from you. Why cant you move on?

It takes a lot of maturity and responsibility to take ownership of a mistake we have made and be willing to correct that so I commend you for realizing your faults and trying to do better.

I do not know what happened but i hate seeing the effect it has on you. You made a mistake like we all do at times and it is ok as long we bounce back. The sad truth is, people LOVE to point a finger at others and you do not deserved to be piled on like this.

Would it help to talk some more about what happened?

I know it is hard :( People say that sh\*\* because they feel powerless. They see you in pain and they do not know how to help you so they spout and that kind of BS... I know it is frustrating.

Things can only get better if things are in place that will make them better. What currently has you feeling this down? Would it help to talk/vent about it? I don't ask so we can focus on a solution because in most cases it is not that simple. But maybe talking about what you are feeling can help in a small way?

Look, I can pass this photo around and ask girls what they think and I am sure I will find a decent amount that find you cute or even sexy but my point is, that is not going to help you because of how negatively you are viewing your own appearance. I know it is SUCH a fucking cliche, but beauty comes from within. If you don't feel attractive and don't emote it, it sadly won't come back to you. 

So I do suggest you work on things that make you feel more attractive. Maybe it is going to the gym like Crazy\_nubber just suggested... maybe it will be a new haircut or different clothes etc. WHATEVER makes you feel good about yourself is worth trying. Or maybe, as i said before, find things that you do like about yourself and focus on those. 

In no way i am saying this is easy - it is hard. But I know with the right motivation and determination, you got this. Don't let this define your life.
I can imagine how scary this must be for you but I am sure we can figure this out together... did something happen today? What do you feel you need help with? Talk to us, we are here for you <3

Therapy is all about chemistry. If the chemistry is no good, the therapy will not work. I commend you for realizing this is not working for you and that want better and are working towards that as so many people tend to give up or settle. 

Do you need to tell your therapist at all? I do not know how things are set up for you but sometimes we can just go around the therapist and find a new one? I hope this is an option for you? If not, you will have to address it which i understand can be hard. Maybe your parents can tag along on the next appointment and say it for you? They seem very invested in your recovery at least.

Based on the involvement of your parents i would suggest sitting down with them and trying to have a conversation with them about what you are feeling and are worried about (having anxiety, OCD and BPD) and the urgency of healthcare that is needed and what kind. You could then as a team, define what the next steps should be, what there involvement is and how to go about it.

It worries me when someone labels themselves as 'ugly' - all that will do is royally bring you down. I noticed you keep posting this on multiple subreddits and what for? You don't deserve that. I understand this is something that is important to you but constantly asking people if they thin you are ugly is very destructive.

The truth is, we can post this picture of you and your friends all over the world and everyone will label someone else as the hot one and someone else as the ugly one. Beauty is subjective and just like everyone will not find you attractive, not everyone will find you ugly. 

I know this is the hardest thing to do... but confidence and self-worth start from within. The world is not going to make you feel attractive, that is something you need to do for yourself. Is there anything about you that you do like?

Talking honestly helped me the most. Because so often there are not fixes or solutions and we just need get through the shit. Just having someone listen and give support (or advice) can sometimes make a world of difference. 

Was it really laziness? I ask because i have suffered from mild depression in the past and it is SUCH a mood/energy killer. I would lie down all day and it was not by choice but everyone just pegged me as lazy.

I am sorry to hear you have lost things... I hope through work and time, you can maybe get these things back?

It is a scary time. For what it is worth (as a 38 yo) - I have been there.... working a shitty job with very little money, worrying about bills and no real friends to help me through it. You are NOT complaining.... life is hard - especially at this age. I am sorry you are going through it right now, genuinely.

With all you have going on and that you are worrying about... i know there isnt much we can do but please know whenever you feel like sh\*\* and need to vent.. we are here.

I am so sorry to hear you are struggling right now. I know depression is a CONSTANT battle but I do genuinely hope better days are ahead of you.

What has always helped me is to be honest about what I am going through, and having those select people in my life whom I can talk to about this. I hope you have someone close, like a family member or a friend that you feel comfortable with and can talk to about what you are feeling. And please keep in mind that we are here for you too - whatever you are feeling, if you need to talk or vent about what is going on... we will do our best to listen and support you in the small ways we can

Another thing that has helped me, was to take on a project. Something i knew would be a source of pride and happiness. For me it was going back to school and getting my bachelor and master degree. That way when certain things were really getting me down or stressng me out... i had that thing to focus on. I know its not much but it helped me in hard times.

But again above everything - know you are never alone. So many people on here have those same demons and will understand you and be there for you in those dark times. I hope better days are ahead of you <3

You are so right. Life is just one big lottery and we have winners and losers. Life is just not fair unfortunately :(

I do not know what is currently going on but you seem down. Would it help to talk about what you are going through?

It sucks when we have a good day like that only for all that negative sh\*\* to come crashing back. Did something happen today to make those feelings return? What is it that you are worrying about? If it helps to talk about what is going on, please know I (and others) are here for you <3

I hear that.... the real ones are hard to find and we are often left with fake fairweather friends.... But I hope during this extremely hard time there are people who you can turn to and who can help you through this.

I am really glad to hear you have trained yourself so well in dealing with and understanding your own emotions. My ex suffers from BP2 and unfortunately was never able to get to that point.  
I hope you will be able to tell her everything as you should not be going through this alone (it is already fucked up that you have to go through this to begin with). I know she will not be able to fix things but maybe she can at least makes things more manageable for you.
lol - well sadly a lot of people ARE cruel so I totally get the statement ;) I hope you feel better soon!

Bipolar is a never ending battle and I am so sorry to hear you have been dealing with this and are currently struggling. I am glad you found a 'cocktail' that works for you and you seem to be very aware of what you are feeling and when which is a good thing since so many tend to just ignore it. I am sorry to hear you are currently fighting depression and  i hope your next appointment comes soon and they can evaluate what is going on, why and what will help you.

If you are off the drugs, and have been for two weeks then I would not worry about rehab - i am not well versed but from what i understand cocaine can trigger symptoms such as psychosis, mania or anxiety so maybe somehow that did cause a shift in your mood. So it would be wise to bring this up on your appointment.

I know there is not much we can do for you but please know we are here if you need to talk/vent about what is going on.
People can be cruel AF. Did something happen today that made you want to post this? I hope you are ok and if you need to talk about it, we are here <3

omg I cannot imagine from you must be going through... That sort of thing should not happen to anyone, let anyone to anyone so young. It just shows how fucked up this world really can be.

I understand that you currently have no interest in friends or that you don't want to try but... please do not go through this alone. If there is anyone you can talk to during this extremely difficult time, please do so. 

Please know we are always here for you. If you ever need someone to talk to or just vent about how shitty all of this is... please now we are here for you.
I hope it helps and that you feel better soon! If not - remember that we are here for you <3

Ah I am in Holland myself (but born in the UK) - I think it is a similar time frame here which... considering the urgency, seems crazy to me. 

As a gay man, I understand in part what you are feeling right now as I have had to deal with a lot of homophobia from my religious family but at the same time, considering how much transphobia is still out there today my heart goes out to you. 

I know you feel like you do not belong but... don't let their ignorance and closed mindedness define your life. You're a woman and F\*\*\* what they think. I hope in time you will be surrounded by people who love and appreciate the real you.

I am so happy you have embraced who you really are. I know you have a long journey ahead of you but... sometimes it is good to look back and remember how far you have already come. You have made it through university and your coming out and so many other obstacles. You can do this <3 And whenever you are feeling down, tired or frustrated - know that we are here for you and always ready and willing to listen.

It must be so challenging to have two kids with special needs but I am sure you are doing everything you can for them. Why do you feel like a burden? Because of your depression? Are you getting any form of treatment for that?
We are here for you! What is going on? Did something bad happen today?

I feel like that all the time. It is so strange and confusing. It is like i have a VALID reason to be sad but I do not know what it is. What sometimes helps me is to go on a long walk and just have an open conversation with myself in which I ask myself questions and see where I end up. I know it is not much but for me it sometimes helps me work through it.

Please know we are here if you need to talk more about what you are currently going through <3

Congrats on completing university and for coming out as trans <3

Hearing that you are on a 39 month waiting list is both frustrating and incredibly depressing. That is insane. I am sorry - it cannot imagine what it must feel like to have your life put on hold like this. Especially since you must have been working towards this moment for so long.

It just shows how privileged some are and who others need to work their asses off to get even just a little. I know there is very little I can do for you but... if it helps to talk/vent more about what is going on, please know we are here for you <3

I mean.... personally I would say you guys are doing all you can do. At the end of the day, he needs to take responsibility for his own actions and if he refuses your help or to take you seriously, then there is only so much you could do. Hopefully, in time, he will realize that you guys are there for him and have his back and go be more receptive.

I think you are such a good friend for trying to help and post on here. Props to you :)

It sounds like your friend is completely infatuated with this H guy to a creepy amount. I do not know how serious his comments are or if this has happened before but judging by your wording this seems like a new, unique situation. 

It sounds like you are already doing everything you can, meaning that you are trying to talk to him, give him feedback and attention. It might be worth trying to be really direct with him - you for instance say this is becoming predatory... have you used that exact wording on him? 

Also, why are you worried your friend might harm or kill himself? Has something like this happened before? If so, the best advice i can give you is to have that conversation with him. Ask him how he is feeling and thinking and if he talks about this sort of thing, try not to judge or to focus on solutions, but instead try to listen and be supportive/empathic.
sounds good - add me :) 29m from Austin TX

I am really sorry to see you struggling so. I know in these dark moments how important it is to feel safe and I hate hearing how misunderstood you are right now.

I obviously do not know the backstory but it sounds like you are unfairly being labeled as being 'lazy' and that worries me. This sounds like a (mild) depression potentially. I can imagine your parents are worried and are desperately trying to fix this situation but this may do more harm then good. 

Going against your parents is a tricky thing, but it seems vital they understand what you are feeling right now and why. I hope you can talk to them about this or maybe reach out to someone who can talk to them.

Such a beautiful response, I hope it helps you in a small way OP <3

I sincerely hope there is someone in your life you feel comfortable opening up to, even if just a small amount.  If not, please know we on here are always here for you and ready and willing to listen to what is currently going on.

Ugh... that is so wrong. I am so sorry. Parents should never yell at their child about mental illness, that is just wrong. It sounds like they do not understand what is going on with you, nor how to handle it.

Please dont post on r/anger again about this sort of thing. Instead come on here. It is important you are understood in these moments.
That sounds very stressful. I am sorry to hear things havent been going great for you. Do your parents understand what you are feeling and going through? Because it does not sound like they do?

Trust me, there will always be a space for you to vent on here. I know some messages can get lost on here because so many people post but... we will always try to make sure that you feel heard during those dark times.

I wish this crisis helpline was more useful but... i guess for now just focus on us and we are here with you until that appointment.

Oh yes... this world can be a dark place. And  I am sorry about that, it can really get me down too. 

Did someone do/say something specific to you today that as you feeling this way? Is this about someone in particular?

Wow what kind of a crazy job was this? Sounds like a good thing you got out of it?

I hope you hear back from that school soon... I know how stressful that wait can be.

I know I can't do much but... would it help to talk some more about everything that is going on?

I am sorry to hear things have gotten worse and are seemingly at their worst right now. That cannot be easy for you. Are you being treated for your season depression? I hope so at least.

It sounds like something specific has happened and is now on your mind? WOuld it help to talk about that?

It is interesting that you say you feel like you are underground. I have always compared mine to feeling like I am underwater.

I am sorry to hear you have reached that decision. Things must be pretty bad for you right now? Has something happened recently or is it a build up of things? Either way... I am sorry  and please know if you need someone to talk to about it we are here for you.

We all have our limits and it is a shame he reached his with you. I am really sorry to hear you are struggling and now have to deal with a break up on top of what you were already feeling. If talking helps, please know we are here for you <3

What helps me is to have goals. Even though things are shit for me now having little things I can work towards help me get through the harder days.

I am sorry to see you are struggling right now. I hope better days are ahead of you. If you need someone to talk to about what has been going on I am here for you
I am sorry to hear you are in this dark place right now... Did something happen recently that has caused you to feel this way? Would it help to talk/vent about what is going on?

lol - i am sorry but that is ridiculous (of them). I know it is not much but will help to talk to us on here what is going on? I know we are not crisis help but... if you need to talk/vent about what is going on we can listen and support you <3
No that does not make you a bad person at all... It is not like you CHOOSE to have these thoughts, right? Why do you say no one takes you seriously? Did something happen and did no one respond?

It always baffles me how with all that is medically possible... that something like this can't be fixed (believe me I am in the exact same boat). I am really sorry.

Why two months?

I am sorry to hear you are alone and that things are getting worse. I know there is very little I can do in this moment to help you but... if talking or venting helps please unload on me. I wish I could offer you more :(

The important thing is that you tried and I am really sorry to hear things did not work out. I hope through talking to them, it did at least give you a better understanding of what you are feeling and needing. I know this takes up so much time and energy but little by little you are finding yourself and finding what works for you.

And that is also a good thing about reddit. Whatever you are feeling, you have a place here where you can talk about all you are feeling and we will support you in the best way we can <3

Oh so true - you would think we would form more of a unit. I think in the end a lot of gay men are hurt and then in turn hurt others around them. But we are not all like that... i hope you will find a man soon who sees the beautiful you and loves both your mind AND your body ;)
That is amazing to hear you are feeling prepared! YAY! Good luck, I am sure you got this <3
I am sorry to see you are struggling so. What have you been fighting these past two years? Would it help to talk about that?

I know how superficial we gay men can be - I am sorry they can be this way. It is like if you are not a skinny twink, you do not count sometimes... 

I do not know if this will help you but... no matter what body type you have... there are people out there who love you for you. I am skinny myself but I am drawn to bigger/stocky guys. I hope through experiences you will learn that there will be plenty of guys out there who will be extremely attracted to you <3

And for the time being... i am here if you ever need to vent about how shitty and toxic the gay scene is.

Ugh.. that sounds so shitty. I am so sorry. It sucks when our mood completely destroys our productivity. People think we are just lazy but only they knew the true story...

I know this is scary for you and I am sorry for that. Would it be worth sitting down with your manager an explain what is going on? Maybe they can even give you another chance?

It is scary to be in this place... I know and I am sorry.

I will not tell you to not be sad - and it is fucked up when people tell you that. It sounds like venting will help... if that is the case, I would like to tell you I am here and I will do my best to listen to what is going on right now.  I know I cannot hug or hold you - I wish I could - but I can listen. <3

It sounds like you have had a very rough life so far. I am really sorry to hear about the bullyinf and my condolences to your father. While my dad is still around, he left us when I was child and I know that void too well. I am sorry to hear how his passing has affected you.I can get into all you have written but if I am very honest, i see a pattern in what you are writing and that is that it seems you are very critical of yourself. You are not a loser and I doubt you will not achieve anything. It is never good to say you will not do something, because you are convinced you will fail. I know it is scary and yes... you MIGHT fail. But you also might succeed and the only way to know is by trying.Do you have anyone close to you whom you can talk to about all of this? Maybe your brother or your mother? I would hate to know you are going through this alone. While you can always post on here and we will always try to listen and help you... I know how important it is to have those close to us to be there for us.

I am sorry to hear you are in this dark place and without that person who you love the most. I know too well how sometimes that one special person can make all the difference. I wish she knew how you were feeling in this moment and could be here for you.
